questions.question: What does Isaiah 44 mock at length?
options: The folly of making idols from wood, then worshiping them
The great laziness of all those who simply will not work
The boundless pride of kings who exalt their own selves
The endless greed of the merchants out in the marketplace
questions.answer: The folly of making idols from wood, then worshiping them

questions.question: How does God describe himself in Isaiah 44?
options: One among the many gods worshiped by the nations
A god far off and hidden, whom none can ever find
The first and the last; besides me there is no god
A distant maker who has forgotten the work of his hands
questions.answer: The first and the last; besides me there is no god
